name: ghostty-landscapes
description: Ten independently animated illustrated landscapes for Ghostty

scripts.build: node shader/build-rain.cjs && node collection/prepare.cjs && node collection/build.cjs
scripts.check:syntax: python3 -m compileall -q bin/ghost-bg install.py tests && for file in collection/*.cjs collection/gallery.js shader/*.cjs; do node --check "$file" || exit; done
scripts.test: npm run check:syntax && npm run check && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
